S1177.reason: UNCLOS Art. 62 requires the coastal State to give other States access to any surplus of the total allowable catch it cannot harvest, with special regard to developing, land-locked, and geographically disadvantaged States.

S1080.reason: Under transferred intent, the man's intent to batter the manager transfers to the customer who was actually struck, so the battery claim succeeds.
